title: Japanese-Style Salad with Crispy Feta
description: A simple and refreshing salad with a crispy feta topping, inspired by Japanese flavors.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the fresh greens and fragrant salad.
2. Slice the Dutch cucumber into thin rounds and add to the bowl.
3. Crumble the feta cheese into small pieces and set aside.
4. In a small pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
5. Add the crumbled feta cheese to the pan and cook until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
6. Remove the pan from the heat and let the feta cool slightly.
7. Sprinkle the crispy feta cheese over the salad and serve immediately.
8. Garnish with sesame seeds and a drizzle of soy sauce, if desired.
